submitted.rationale: Highest measured photocurrent: 26.5 µA at 455 nm. It sits in the Bi-rich, V-rich BiVO4 region. At the neighbouring composition 60, XRD shows mainly monoclinic BiVO4, which is the known visible-light photoanode phase (bandgap about 2.4 eV, below the 2.72 eV photons). Composition 22 has about twice the photocurrent of 60, and much more than the copper vanadate composition 77.

rejected.reason: Measured 12.6 µA. XRD shows mainly BiVO4, but its photocurrent is lower than 22's.
Measured 4.6 µA. XRD shows a copper vanadate mixed with BiVO4, and the photocurrent is poor.
CuBi2O4 is a p-type photocathode, so it is unlikely to work as a photoanode. Not measured.
XRD shows extra secondary-phase peaks alongside BiVO4. Not measured.
